name: Walking With Jesus
overview: Walking with Jesus involves a deliberate choice to avoid ungodly counsel and sinful paths, embracing instead a humble and obedient relationship with God as taught in Micah 6:8. Scripture assures believers of God's sustaining presence and strength, promising rest for the weary and guidance like a shepherd who provides all that is needed. This journey is marked by trust in God's help and righteousness, encouraging believers to live justly and mercifully while relying on His steadfast support.
